items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section III, List of Answers on Topics 75:1
items.html: They indicate in particular the ZA and Malchut of phase four, which separated and became surrounding ones. And because of this, from the world of Nekudim onward, the inner Haya and Yechida were lacking in all the Partzufim.
